description: PostgreSQL 18 domain typmods, defaults, nullability, checks, arrays, catalogs, and ALTER lifecycle
sql: CREATE DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount AS NUMERIC(8,2) DEFAULT 1.20 CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_required NOT NULL CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_positive CHECK (VALUE > 0);
CREATE DOMAIN type_matrix_array_amount AS NUMERIC(8,2);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_domain_rows (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, amount type_matrix_positive_amount, history type_matrix_array_amount[]);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_domain_rows (id) VALUES ('defaulted');
INSERT INTO type_matrix_domain_rows VALUES ('explicit', 12.345, '[0:2]={1.234,2,9.999}');
SELECT id, amount, array_dims(history), history FROM type_matrix_domain_rows ORDER BY id;
SELECT typtype, typcategory, typbasetype, typtypmod, typnotnull, typinput, typoutput, typreceive, typsend, typdefault FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'type_matrix_positive_amount';
SELECT conname, contype, conrelid, convalidated FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'type_matrix_amount_positive';
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount ADD CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_ceiling CHECK (VALUE < 1000) NOT VALID;
SELECT conname, convalidated FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'type_matrix_amount_ceiling';
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount VALIDATE CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_ceiling;
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount RENAME CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_ceiling TO type_matrix_amount_bounded;
SELECT conname, convalidated FROM pg_constraint WHERE contypid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'type_matrix_positive_amount') ORDER BY conname;
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount DROP CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_bounded;
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount RENAME CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_required TO type_matrix_amount_present;
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount VALIDATE CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_present;
ALTER DOMAIN type_matrix_positive_amount DROP CONSTRAINT type_matrix_amount_present;
SELECT typnotnull FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'type_matrix_positive_amount';
